candidate.title: inDrop
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina inDrop schematic: indexing-droplet single-cell poly(A)+ RNA profiling with hydrogel-bound photocleavable barcoding primers, UV release, droplet pooling, a broad cDNA synthesis/amplification block, and sequencing. The matching collection-page heading and caption identify this target. The oligo/hydrogel panels define the microsphere component; the far-left cell-to-poly(A) icon summarizes the analyte, rather than depicting a separate extraction branch. The diagram's staged route is retained, with the original Klein et al. implementation used to clarify co-encapsulation, barcoding before droplet breaking, and the DNA library carrier. Listed similar methods, associated kits, background applications and the embedded CEL-Seq library component are not additional workflow targets.
